question.text: Which figure shows the correct variation of applied potential difference (V) with photoelectric current (I) at two different intensities of light $\left(\mathrm{I}_1 \lt \mathrm{I}_2\right)$ of same wavelengths:

solution.text: Given lights are of same wavelength and stopping potential is independent on intensity. Hence stopping potential will remain same. Intensity $\mathrm{I}_2\gt\mathrm{I}_1$, hence saturation current corresponding to $\mathrm{I}_2$ will be greater than that corresponding to $\mathrm{I}_1$.
